local ReachSphere, ReachVisual = nil, nil
local TouchCooldowns = {}
local TouchInterval = 0.15
local OverlapFilter = OverlapParams.new()
OverlapFilter.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
local function UpdateCharacterFilter()
    local filterCharacter = LocalPlayer.Character
    if filterCharacter then
        OverlapFilter.FilterDescendantsInstances = {filterCharacter}
    end
end
if LocalPlayer.Character then
    UpdateCharacterFilter()
end
LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(UpdateCharacterFilter)
local function IsBallPart(candidatePart)
    if not candidatePart or not candidatePart:IsA("BasePart") then
        return false
    end
    local ballPartName = candidatePart.Name:lower()
    return ballPartName == "tps" or ballPartName == "ball" or ballPartName == "bola" or ballPartName == "soccerball" or ballPartName:find("ball") or ballPartName:find("bola")
end
local function UpdateReachSphere()
    local reachCharacter = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not reachCharacter then
        return
    end
    local reachRootPart = reachCharacter:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not reachRootPart then
        return
    end
    if not ReachSettings.Ativo then
        if ReachSphere then
            ReachSphere:Destroy();
            ReachSphere = nil
        end
        if ReachVisual then
            ReachVisual:Destroy();
            ReachVisual = nil
        end
        return
    end
    local reachDiameter = ReachSettings.Tamanho * 2
    if not ReachSphere then
        ReachSphere = Instance.new("Part")
        ReachSphere.Name = "AstralReachSphere"
        ReachSphere.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
        ReachSphere.Anchored = true
        ReachSphere.CanCollide = false
        ReachSphere.CanQuery = false
        ReachSphere.CanTouch = false
        ReachSphere.Transparency = 1
        ReachSphere.Massless = true
        ReachSphere.Parent = Workspace
    end
    ReachSphere.Size = Vector3.new(reachDiameter, reachDiameter, reachDiameter)
    ReachSphere.CFrame = CFrame.new(reachRootPart.Position)
    if ReachSettings.Visualizador then
        if not ReachVisual then
            ReachVisual = Instance.new("Part")
            ReachVisual.Name = "AstralReachVisual"
            ReachVisual.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
            ReachVisual.Anchored = true
            ReachVisual.CanCollide = false
            ReachVisual.CanQuery = false
            ReachVisual.CanTouch = false
            ReachVisual.Material = Enum.Material.ForceField
            ReachVisual.Color = Color3.fromRGB(130, 50, 200)
            ReachVisual.Transparency = 0.75
            ReachVisual.Massless = true
            ReachVisual.Parent = Workspace
        end
        ReachVisual.Size = Vector3.new(reachDiameter, reachDiameter, reachDiameter)
        ReachVisual.CFrame = CFrame.new(reachRootPart.Position)
    else
        if ReachVisual then
            ReachVisual:Destroy();
            ReachVisual = nil
        end
    end
end
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(UpdateReachSphere)
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    if not ReachSettings.Ativo then
        return
    end
    if not ReachSphere or not ReachSphere.Parent then
        return
    end
    local touchCharacter = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not touchCharacter then
        return
    end
    local touchRootPart = touchCharacter:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not touchRootPart then
        return
    end
    local touchNow = os.clock()
    local touchPartsInRadius = Workspace:GetPartBoundsInRadius(ReachSphere.Position, ReachSettings.Tamanho, OverlapFilter)
    for touchIndex, touchCandidate in ipairs(touchPartsInRadius) do
        if IsBallPart(touchCandidate) then
            local touchCandidatePath = touchCandidate:GetFullName()
            if not TouchCooldowns[touchCandidatePath] or touchNow - TouchCooldowns[touchCandidatePath] > TouchInterval then
                TouchCooldowns[touchCandidatePath] = touchNow
                pcall(function()
                    firetouchinterest(touchCandidate, touchRootPart, 0)
                    firetouchinterest(touchCandidate, touchRootPart, 1)
                    local leftFoot = touchCharacter:FindFirstChild("Left Foot") or touchCharacter:FindFirstChild("Left Leg")
                    local rightFoot = touchCharacter:FindFirstChild("Right Foot") or touchCharacter:FindFirstChild("Right Leg")
                    if leftFoot then
                        firetouchinterest(touchCandidate, leftFoot, 0);
                        firetouchinterest(touchCandidate, leftFoot, 1)
                    end
                    if rightFoot then
                        firetouchinterest(touchCandidate, rightFoot, 0);
                        firetouchinterest(touchCandidate, rightFoot, 1)
                    end
                end)
            end
        end
    end
end)
local PowerShootSettings = {Ativo = false, Forca = 5, Cooldown = 0.5, LastKick = 0}
local KickDetectionRadius = 3
local CurveSettings = {Ativo = false, Side = "None", CPower = 0, DPower = 0, Dip = false}
local CurvePresets = {["Esquerda"] = {side = "Left", dip = true, cPower = 60, dPower = 20},["Direita"] = {side = "Right", dip = false, cPower = 80, dPower = 0},}
local BallControlSettings = {Ativo = false, BallSpeed = 70, CameraDistance = 16, CameraHeight = 6, MouseSensitivity = 0.004, TouchSensitivity = 0.006,}
local BallControlActive, ControlledBall = false, nil
local BallRenderConnection, BallInputConnection = nil, nil
local SavedCameraType, SavedCameraSubject
local CameraYaw, CameraPitch = 0, 0.2
local CachedBall, LastBallScan = nil, 0
local function FindCachedBall()
    if CachedBall and CachedBall.Parent and os.clock() - LastBallScan < 0.3 then
        return CachedBall
    end
    LastBallScan = os.clock()
    for cachedScanIndex, cachedScanPart in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if cachedScanPart:IsA("BasePart") and cachedScanPart.Name == "TPS" then
            CachedBall = cachedScanPart
            return cachedScanPart
        end
    end
    CachedBall = nil
    return nil
end
local function FindNearestBall()
    local nearestRootPart = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not nearestRootPart then
        return nil
    end
    local nearestBall, nearestDistance = nil, 80
    for nearestScanIndex, nearestScanCandidate in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if nearestScanCandidate.Name == "TPS" then
            local nearestCandidatePart = nearestScanCandidate:IsA("Model") and(nearestScanCandidate.PrimaryPart or nearestScanCandidate:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")) or(nearestScanCandidate:IsA("BasePart") and nearestScanCandidate)
            if nearestCandidatePart then
                local candidateDistance =(nearestCandidatePart.Position - nearestRootPart.Position).Magnitude
                if candidateDistance < nearestDistance then
                    nearestDistance = candidateDistance;
                    nearestBall = nearestScanCandidate
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return nearestBall
end
local function EnableCurve(curvePresetName)
    local curvePreset = CurvePresets[curvePresetName]
    if not curvePreset then
        CurveSettings.Ativo = false;
        return
    end
    CurveSettings.Side = curvePreset.side
    CurveSettings.Dip = curvePreset.dip
    CurveSettings.CPower = curvePreset.cPower
    CurveSettings.DPower = curvePreset.dPower
    CurveSettings.Ativo = true
end
local function ApplyPowerShoot(kickBall)
    if not PowerShootSettings.Ativo then
        return
    end
    if tick() - PowerShootSettings.LastKick < PowerShootSettings.Cooldown then
        return
    end
    local kickCharacter = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not kickCharacter then
        return
    end
    local kickRootPart = kickCharacter:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local kickHumanoid = kickCharacter:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not kickRootPart or not kickHumanoid or kickHumanoid.MoveDirection.Magnitude < 0.1 then
        return
    end
    if(kickBall.Position - kickRootPart.Position).Unit:Dot(kickHumanoid.MoveDirection.Unit) > 0.5 then
        PowerShootSettings.LastKick = tick()
        pcall(function()
            local oldKickVelocity = kickBall:FindFirstChild("KickForce")
            if oldKickVelocity then
                oldKickVelocity:Destroy()
            end
            local kickVelocity = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
            kickVelocity.Name = "KickForce"
            kickVelocity.Velocity = kickRootPart.CFrame.LookVector * PowerShootSettings.Forca * 45 + Vector3.new(0, PowerShootSettings.Forca * 9, 0)
            kickVelocity.MaxForce = Vector3.new(1e9, 1e9, 1e9)
            kickVelocity.Parent = kickBall
            task.delay(0.15, function()
                if kickVelocity and kickVelocity.Parent then
                    kickVelocity:Destroy()
                end
            end)
        end)
    end
end
local function RestoreCamera()
    if SavedCameraType and SavedCameraSubject then
        Workspace.CurrentCamera.CameraType = SavedCameraType
        Workspace.CurrentCamera.CameraSubject = SavedCameraSubject
    end
    UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.Default
end
local function StopBallControl()
    BallControlActive = false
    if BallRenderConnection then
        BallRenderConnection:Disconnect();
        BallRenderConnection = nil
    end
    if BallInputConnection then
        BallInputConnection:Disconnect();
        BallInputConnection = nil
    end
    RestoreCamera()
    ControlledBall = nil
end
local function StartBallControl(ballTarget)
    if BallRenderConnection then
        BallRenderConnection:Disconnect()
    end
    if BallInputConnection then
        BallInputConnection:Disconnect()
    end
    local targetBallPart = ballTarget:IsA("Model") and(ballTarget.PrimaryPart or ballTarget:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")) or ballTarget
    if not targetBallPart or not targetBallPart:IsA("BasePart") then
        StopBallControl();
        return
    end
    ControlledBall = targetBallPart
    BallControlActive = true
    local ballCamera = Workspace.CurrentCamera SavedCameraType, SavedCameraSubject = ballCamera.CameraType, ballCamera.CameraSubject
    local initialLookVector = ballCamera.CFrame.LookVector
    CameraYaw = math.atan2(- initialLookVector.X, - initialLookVector.Z)
    CameraPitch = math.asin(math.clamp(initialLookVector.Y, - 1, 1))
    ballCamera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
    UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.LockCenter
    BallInputConnection = UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(inputChange)
        if not BallControlActive then
            return
        end
        if inputChange.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
            CameraYaw = CameraYaw - inputChange.Delta.X * BallControlSettings.MouseSensitivity
            CameraPitch = math.clamp(CameraPitch - inputChange.Delta.Y * BallControlSettings.MouseSensitivity, - 1.2, 1.2)
        elseif inputChange.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            CameraYaw = CameraYaw - inputChange.Delta.X * BallControlSettings.TouchSensitivity
            CameraPitch = math.clamp(CameraPitch - inputChange.Delta.Y * BallControlSettings.TouchSensitivity, - 1.2, 1.2)
        end
    end)
    BallRenderConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if not BallControlActive or not ControlledBall or not ControlledBall.Parent then
            StopBallControl();
            return
        end
        if UserInputService.MouseBehavior ~= Enum.MouseBehavior.LockCenter then
            UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.LockCenter
        end
        local controlLookVector = CFrame.fromEulerAnglesYXZ(CameraPitch, CameraYaw, 0).LookVector
        pcall(function()
            ControlledBall.AssemblyLinearVelocity = controlLookVector * BallControlSettings.BallSpeed
            ControlledBall.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
        end)
        Workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(ControlledBall.Position - controlLookVector * BallControlSettings.CameraDistance + Vector3.new(0, BallControlSettings.CameraHeight, 0), ControlledBall.Position + Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0))
    end)
end
local function ToggleBallControl()
    if BallControlActive then
        StopBallControl()
    else
        local nearestBallToControl = FindNearestBall()
        if nearestBallToControl then
            StartBallControl(nearestBallToControl)
        else
            print("[Troll] Ball not found!")
        end
    end
end
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    if CurveSettings.Ativo then
        local curveBall = FindCachedBall()
        if curveBall and curveBall:IsA("BasePart") then
            local ballVelocity = curveBall.AssemblyLinearVelocity
            if ballVelocity.Magnitude > 15 then
                if CurveSettings.Side ~= "None" or CurveSettings.Dip then
                    local curveOffset = Vector3.zero
                    local horizontalVelocity = Vector3.new(ballVelocity.X, 0, ballVelocity.Z)
                    if CurveSettings.Side ~= "None" and horizontalVelocity.Magnitude > 2 then
                        local lateralDirection = horizontalVelocity:Cross(Vector3.yAxis).Unit
                        if CurveSettings.Side == "Left" then
                            lateralDirection = - lateralDirection
                        end
                        curveOffset = curveOffset + lateralDirection *(CurveSettings.CPower / 180)
                    end
                    if CurveSettings.Dip then
                        curveOffset = curveOffset + Vector3.new(0, -(CurveSettings.DPower / 180), 0)
                    end
                    curveBall.AssemblyLinearVelocity = ballVelocity + curveOffset
                end
            end
        end
    end
    if PowerShootSettings.Ativo and PowerShootSettings.Forca > 0 then
        local shootCharacter = LocalPlayer.Character
        if shootCharacter then
            local shootRootPart = shootCharacter:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if shootRootPart then
                for shootScanIndex, shootCandidateBall in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
                    if shootCandidateBall:IsA("BasePart") and shootCandidateBall.Name == "TPS" and(shootCandidateBall.Position - shootRootPart.Position).Magnitude <= KickDetectionRadius then
                        ApplyPowerShoot(shootCandidateBall)
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
end)
local AutoCatchActive = false
local CatchDistance = 5
local CatchEnabled = true
local LastCatchTime = 0
local CatchCooldown = 0.3
local BallCaught = false
local CatchBallRemote = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("CatchBall")
local DropBallRemote = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("DropBall")
local CatchBallCache, LastCatchBallScan = nil, 0
local function FindCatchBall()
    if CatchBallCache and CatchBallCache.Parent and os.clock() - LastCatchBallScan < 0.3 then
        return CatchBallCache
    end
    LastCatchBallScan = os.clock()
    for catchScanIndex, catchScanCandidate in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if catchScanCandidate:IsA("BasePart") and catchScanCandidate.Name == "TPS" then
            CatchBallCache = catchScanCandidate
            return catchScanCandidate
        end
    end
    CatchBallCache = nil
    return nil
end
local function TryAutoCatch()
    if not CatchBallRemote or not CatchEnabled or tick() - LastCatchTime < CatchCooldown then
        return
    end
    local catchBall = FindCatchBall()
    if not catchBall then
        return
    end
    local catchOwner = catchBall:FindFirstChild("Owner")
    if catchOwner and catchOwner.Value ~= LocalPlayer and catchOwner.Value ~= nil then
        return
    end
    local catchRootPart = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not catchRootPart then
        return
    end
    if(catchBall.Position - catchRootPart.Position).Magnitude <= CatchDistance then
        pcall(function()
            CatchBallRemote:FireServer(catchBall)
            LastCatchTime = tick()
            BallCaught = true
            task.wait(0.1)
        end)
    end
end
local function DropCaughtBall()
    if DropBallRemote then
        pcall(function()
            DropBallRemote:FireServer()
            BallCaught = false
        end)
    end
end
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    if not AutoCatchActive then
        return
    end
    if not CatchEnabled then
        return
    end
    if BallCaught then
        local trackedCaughtBall = FindCatchBall()
        if not trackedCaughtBall or(trackedCaughtBall.Position - LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position).Magnitude > CatchDistance + 2 then
            BallCaught = false
        end
        return
    end
    TryAutoCatch()
end)
local AutoDiveStarted = false
local function LaunchAutoDive()
    if AutoDiveStarted then
        print("[GK] Auto Dive já está rodando.")
        return
    end
    AutoDiveStarted = true
    task.spawn(function()
        local autoDiveSucceeded, autoDiveError = pcall(function()
            loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://pastefy.app/x5Yia2Gq/raw?t=" .. tick()))()
        end)
        if not autoDiveSucceeded then
            AutoDiveStarted = false
            print("[GK] Erro ao carregar Auto Dive: " .. tostring(autoDiveError))
        end
    end)
end

local function ApplyBallSkin(requestedBallSkin)
    local selectedBallSkin
    for skinIndex, skinPreset in ipairs(BallSkins) do
        if skinPreset.Name == requestedBallSkin then
            selectedBallSkin = skinPreset
            break
        end
    end
    if not selectedBallSkin then
        return
    end
    for skinPartIndex, skinPart in pairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if skinPart:IsA("BasePart") then
            local skinPartName = string.lower(skinPart.Name)
            if skinPartName == "football" or skinPartName == "ball" or skinPartName == "soccerball" or skinPartName == "tps" or skinPartName == "hitbox" or skinPartName == "bola" or string.find(skinPartName, "tcs") then
                pcall(function()
                    local specialMesh = skinPart:FindFirstChildOfClass("SpecialMesh")
                    if skinPart:IsA("MeshPart") and selectedBallSkin.Mesh ~= "" then
                        skinPart.MeshId = selectedBallSkin.Mesh
                        skinPart.TextureID = selectedBallSkin.Texture
                    elseif selectedBallSkin.Mesh ~= "" then
                        if not specialMesh then
                            specialMesh = Instance.new("SpecialMesh", skinPart)
                        end
                        specialMesh.MeshType = Enum.MeshType.FileMesh
                        specialMesh.MeshId = selectedBallSkin.Mesh
                        specialMesh.TextureId = selectedBallSkin.Texture
                    else
                        if specialMesh then
                            specialMesh:Destroy()
                        end
                        if skinPart:IsA("MeshPart") then
                            skinPart.MeshId = ""
                        end
                        if skinPart:IsA("Part") then
                            skinPart.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
                        end
                    end
                    local hasTexture = false
                    for textureIndex, textureChild in pairs(skinPart:GetChildren()) do
                        if textureChild:IsA("Decal") or textureChild:IsA("Texture") then
                            textureChild.Texture = selectedBallSkin.Texture
                            textureChild.Transparency = 0
                            hasTexture = true
                        end
                    end
                    if not hasTexture and selectedBallSkin.Mesh == "" then
                        local newDecal = Instance.new("Decal", skinPart)
                        newDecal.Face = Enum.NormalId.Front
                        newDecal.Texture = selectedBallSkin.Texture
                    end
                end)
            end
        end
    end
end
local function RemoveBallSkin()
    for resetPartIndex, resetPart in pairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if resetPart:IsA("BasePart") then
            local resetPartName = string.lower(resetPart.Name)
            if resetPartName == "football" or resetPartName == "ball" or resetPartName == "soccerball" or resetPartName == "tps" or resetPartName == "hitbox" or resetPartName == "bola" or string.find(resetPartName, "tcs") then
                pcall(function()
                    if resetPart:IsA("MeshPart") then
                        resetPart.MeshId = ""
                        resetPart.TextureID = ""
                    end
                    local resetSpecialMesh = resetPart:FindFirstChildOfClass("SpecialMesh")
                    if resetSpecialMesh then
                        resetSpecialMesh:Destroy()
                    end
                    if resetPart:IsA("Part") then
                        resetPart.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
                    end
                    for resetChildIndex, resetChild in pairs(resetPart:GetChildren()) do
                        if resetChild:IsA("Decal") or resetChild:IsA("Texture") then
                            resetChild:Destroy()
                        end
                    end
                end)
            end
        end
    end
end

local OriginalSkyboxes = {}
for originalSkyIndex, originalSky in ipairs(Lighting:GetChildren()) do
    if originalSky:IsA("Sky") then
        table.insert(OriginalSkyboxes, originalSky:Clone())
    end
end
local function ClearSkyboxes()
    for clearSkyIndex, skyChild in pairs(Lighting:GetChildren()) do
        if skyChild:IsA("Sky") then
            skyChild:Destroy()
        end
    end
end
local function ApplySkybox(requestedSkyboxName)
    for skyboxIndex, skyboxPreset in ipairs(SkyboxPresets) do
        if skyboxPreset.Name == requestedSkyboxName then
            ClearSkyboxes()
            local newSky = Instance.new("Sky")
            newSky.SkyboxBk = skyboxPreset.Bk
            newSky.SkyboxDn = skyboxPreset.Dn
            newSky.SkyboxFt = skyboxPreset.Ft
            newSky.SkyboxLf = skyboxPreset.Lf
            newSky.SkyboxRt = skyboxPreset.Rt
            newSky.SkyboxUp = skyboxPreset.Up
            newSky.Name = requestedSkyboxName .. "Skybox"
            newSky.Parent = Lighting
            return
        end
    end
end
local function RestoreSkyboxes()
    ClearSkyboxes()
    for restoreSkyIndex, savedSky in ipairs(OriginalSkyboxes) do
        pcall(function()
            savedSky:Clone().Parent = Lighting
        end)
    end
end
local GraphicsSettings = {FOV = 70, Sombras = true, Particulas = true, SemTextura = false,}
local OriginalShadows = Lighting.GlobalShadows
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    if Workspace.CurrentCamera then
        Workspace.CurrentCamera.FieldOfView = GraphicsSettings.FOV
    end
end)
local function UpdateShadows()
    Lighting.GlobalShadows = GraphicsSettings.Sombras
end
local function UpdateParticles()
    for particleScanIndex, particleEffect in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if particleEffect:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or particleEffect:IsA("Fire") or particleEffect:IsA("Smoke") or particleEffect:IsA("Sparkles") then
            particleEffect.Enabled = GraphicsSettings.Particulas
        end
    end
end
local SavedTextures = {}
local function ApplyNoTextures()
    if GraphicsSettings.SemTextura then
        for textureScanIndex, textureObject in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
            if textureObject:IsA("BasePart") then
                if not SavedTextures[textureObject] then
                    SavedTextures[textureObject] = {Material = textureObject.Material, Decals = {}}
                    for savedDecalIndex, savedDecal in ipairs(textureObject:GetChildren()) do
                        if savedDecal:IsA("Decal") or savedDecal:IsA("Texture") then
                            table.insert(SavedTextures[textureObject].Decals, {Decal = savedDecal, Transparency = savedDecal.Transparency})
                        end
                    end
                end
                textureObject.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
                for hideTextureIndex, hiddenTexture in ipairs(textureObject:GetChildren()) do
                    if hiddenTexture:IsA("Decal") or hiddenTexture:IsA("Texture") then
                        hiddenTexture.Transparency = 1
                    end
                end
            elseif textureObject:IsA("Decal") or textureObject:IsA("Texture") then
                textureObject.Transparency = 1
            end
        end
    else
        for materialObject, materialBackup in pairs(SavedTextures) do
            if materialObject and materialObject.Parent then
                materialObject.Material = materialBackup.Material
                for materialDecalIndex, materialDecalBackup in ipairs(materialBackup.Decals) do
                    if materialDecalBackup.Decal and materialDecalBackup.Decal.Parent then
                        materialDecalBackup.Decal.Transparency = materialDecalBackup.Transparency
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        SavedTextures = {}
    end
end
local function EnableAntiLag()
    GraphicsSettings.Sombras = false
    GraphicsSettings.Particulas = false
    GraphicsSettings.SemTextura = true
    UpdateShadows()
    UpdateParticles()
    ApplyNoTextures()
end
local function RestoreGraphics()
    GraphicsSettings.Sombras = true
    GraphicsSettings.Particulas = true
    GraphicsSettings.SemTextura = false
    UpdateShadows()
    UpdateParticles()
    ApplyNoTextures()
end
local OriginalFieldColors = {}
local function FindFieldParts()
    local fieldParts = {}
    for fieldScanIndex, fieldCandidate in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if fieldCandidate:IsA("BasePart") then
            local fieldCandidateName = string.lower(fieldCandidate.Name)
            if(fieldCandidate.Material == Enum.Material.Grass or string.find(fieldCandidateName, "grass") or string.find(fieldCandidateName, "pitch") or string.find(fieldCandidateName, "field") or string.find(fieldCandidateName, "grama")) and not string.find(fieldCandidateName, "line") and not string.find(fieldCandidateName, "linha") then
                table.insert(fieldParts, fieldCandidate)
            end
        end
    end
    return fieldParts
end
local function RememberFieldColors()
    for fieldSaveIndex, fieldToSave in ipairs(FindFieldParts()) do
        if not OriginalFieldColors[fieldToSave] then
            OriginalFieldColors[fieldToSave] = fieldToSave.Color
        end
    end
end
local function ChangeFieldColor(newFieldColor)
    RememberFieldColors()
    for fieldColorPart, fieldColorBackup in pairs(OriginalFieldColors) do
        if fieldColorPart and fieldColorPart.Parent then
            fieldColorPart.Color = newFieldColor
        end
    end
end
local function RestoreFieldColors()
    for restoreFieldPart, restoreColor in pairs(OriginalFieldColors) do
        if restoreFieldPart and restoreFieldPart.Parent then
            restoreFieldPart.Color = restoreColor
        end
    end
end

        DropCaughtBall();

        CatchEnabled = true;
        LastCatchTime = 0
    end
end})

local AutoFollowSection = BallTab:Section({Title = "Auto Follow", Opened = true})
local AutoFollowStarted = false
AutoFollowSection:Button({Title = "⚽ Executar Auto Follow", Callback = function()
    if AutoFollowStarted then
        print("[Ball] Auto Follow já está rodando.")
        return
    end
    AutoFollowStarted = true
    task.spawn(function()
        local autoFollowSucceeded, autoFollowError = pcall(function()
            loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://pastefy.app/N57zcgt8/raw?t=" .. tick()))()
        end)
        if not autoFollowSucceeded then
            AutoFollowStarted = false
            print("[Ball] Erro ao carregar Auto Follow: " .. tostring(autoFollowError))
        end
    end)
end,})

local FieldColorsSection = FieldTab:Section({Title = "Cor do Campo", Opened = true})
FieldColorsSection:Input({Title = "Cor em Hex", Placeholder = "#00FF00", Callback = function(hexFieldColorInput)
    local hexFieldColor = hexFieldColorInput:gsub("#", "")
    local fieldRed = tonumber(hexFieldColor:sub(1, 2), 16) or 0
    local fieldGreen = tonumber(hexFieldColor:sub(3, 4), 16) or 0
    local fieldBlue = tonumber(hexFieldColor:sub(5, 6), 16) or 0
    ChangeFieldColor(Color3.fromRGB(fieldRed, fieldGreen, fieldBlue))
end,})
FieldColorsSection:Button({Title = "🟢 Verde Padrão", Callback = function()
    ChangeFieldColor(Color3.fromRGB(60, 145, 60))
end,})

end,})
